items.title: Dynatrace upgraded by Morgan Stanley as observability demand boosts growth
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley upgraded Dynatrace Inc to Overweight from Equal-weight on Tuesday, saying improving demand for observability software, a large customer renewal cycle and stronger artificial intelligence capabilities could drive a sustained acceleration in growth.

items.title: Emerald AI valued at $1.05 billion after Series A funding round
items.summary: Emerald AI, which develops software to help AI data centers reduce or shift power ‌usage when electricity grids are under stress, said ‌on Tuesday it had raised $150 million in a funding round that valued ​the company at $1.05 billion.  Investor appetite for AI infrastructure startups has intensified over the past year as tech companies race to expand data center capacity, driving up valuations and accelerating funding ‌rounds for firms ⁠addressing bottlenecks such as power availability.  • The company ​said it was transforming ‌AI data centers into flexible grid assets that dynamically adjust power consumption in response to grid conditions.
